name: duplicate-order-states-on-upgrade
description:
Dua OrderState hidup milik module, KEDUANYA memegang order — kondisi yang ditinggalkan build cacat (kunci config shop-scoped membayangi baris global). Reviewer adversarial merakitnya dengan tangan di ronde 5, 6, dan 8.

Yang DIPATOK di sini adalah invarian yang menyentuh PELANGGAN, bukan konsolidasinya. `prestashop:module upgrade` melewati skrip upgrade bila versi DB sudah sama dengan versi file, jadi di jalur ini konsolidasi memang TIDAK terjadi — dan itu bukan cacat ensureOrderState() (lihat duplicate-order-states-on-reset, yang lolos penuh). Yang tak boleh terjadi apa pun jalurnya: nol order boleh terkunci di status yang dipensiunkan, dan status yang dipakai harus tetap mengirim email. Duplikatnya sendiri sembuh saat admin membuka halaman module (getContent memanggil ensureOrderState) atau menekan Reset.
given: SET @orig := (SELECT id_order_state FROM `{prefix}order_state` WHERE module_name='bankwire' AND deleted=0 ORDER BY id_order_state LIMIT 1); INSERT INTO `{prefix}order_state` (invoice,send_email,module_name,color,unremovable,hidden,logable,delivery,shipped,paid,deleted) SELECT invoice,send_email,module_name,color,unremovable,hidden,logable,delivery,shipped,paid,0 FROM `{prefix}order_state` WHERE id_order_state=@orig; SET @dup := LAST_INSERT_ID(); INSERT INTO `{prefix}order_state_lang` (id_order_state,id_lang,name,template) SELECT @dup,id_lang,name,template FROM `{prefix}order_state_lang` WHERE id_order_state=@orig; SET @lo := (SELECT MIN(id_order) FROM `{prefix}orders`); SET @hi := (SELECT MAX(id_order) FROM `{prefix}orders`); UPDATE `{prefix}orders` SET current_state=@orig WHERE id_order=@lo; UPDATE `{prefix}orders` SET current_state=@dup WHERE id_order=@hi;

then.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `{prefix}orders` o JOIN `{prefix}order_state` s ON o.current_state=s.id_order_state WHERE s.module_name='bankwire' AND s.deleted=1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `{prefix}orders` o JOIN `{prefix}order_state` s ON o.current_state=s.id_order_state WHERE s.module_name='bankwire' AND s.deleted=0
SELECT MIN(send_email) FROM `{prefix}order_state` WHERE module_name='bankwire' AND deleted=0
